about: F132 (#1256): the story maps the Knowledge import loads (scripts/knowledge/maps.ts). Hand-kept by agents; the PM rules on journeys and slices in the store. A journey's items get ids from their position here (JY-WEEKEND.A1.T1.D1) when first loaded; after that the store is the truth and a moved item keeps its id. The first map is the 2026-11-11 research note's worked example (socialus-plan planning/research/story-mapping-and-roles-2026-11-11.md). features: where each built feature sits (null: no journey yet). ideas: where each IMAGINE idea would fit, by concept id with its name as a check (null on: no journey yet).

journeys.answer: Members bring something to life together that wasn't here before
journeys.why: The PM, 2026-11-15: "I like that name and theme bring it to life. And it's crucial that the search [will] bring this about." Patrons and producers connect to make something exist that didn't. It is the second half of the soul line two-halves (PRINCIPLES.md, 2026-11-15): discovery is the way in; bringing things to life together is where SocialUs is headed. Hyper-specific search (F136, CO-0063) is the main way it happens. It draws on social capital (CO-0016), reciprocity (CO-0013) and rising tide (CO-0015).

journeys.answer: Members who care shop by their values, and find the owners who share them
journeys.why: The PM, 2026-11-21: "those who think it's important can opt in and those who don't think it's important don't ever have to think about it." Working name Shop by your values. Its heart is the blue dot: a Page shows it only to a viewer when both took the values survey and align enough; everyone else sees nothing. Opt-in on both sides, never inferred, never ranking anyone down; no stalking (PRINCIPLES.md, 2026-11-15). Related: Badges vs values (CO-0029), Locally Made badge (CO-0008), Reciprocity & goodwill (CO-0013), Discovery that knows what a person is optimizing for (CO-0025), hyper-specific search (F136), the two-halves soul line, Bring it to life (JY-BRING), The town before it opens (CO-0065).

journeys.answer: Sacramento opens: people hear about SocialUs, learn what it's for, find out their town is open, and join
journeys.why: The PM, 2026-11-22: "the launch campaign is going to comprise of the new chat search, oriented homepage, and it will also include some sample prompts that teach the users how they can use the site teach the users what the site is intended to be for and tells users whether their market is open or not and this will also include emails that go out to vendors and [patrons] to let them know what we're about and where to find us and why they would want to use us and then I'm also thinking about some kind of outreach campaign alongside this that includes some kind of stickers for businesses to put up to say find us here and there may be more things". Then: "this is the town launch. I'm thinking the sacramento area and for January 1 or so." The Sacramento launch campaign. Room for more: a new step joins as an activity or task here. What each step waits on is a condition (CN-0001 and its parts, CN-0002 to CN-0016). Brief and cut line: socialus-plan planning/briefs/sacramento-launch-campaign-2026-11-22.md. Related: The town before it opens (CO-0065), hyper-specific search (F136), the waitlist (F076), phone sign-up (F081).

journeys.answer: People find out who is local here, know the person they're supporting, and see their place get better
journeys.why: The PM, 2026-11-23: "It's about the person behind the business or the page that's the [know] your seller or know your page owner". Then: "this is going to be bigger than a one time thing this kinda needs to be a big part of owning a page and that for people to communicate that a person's patronage is supporting someone nearby a neighbor or a local if the person is traveling, and that is going to help. This also ties into a page creator identifying which community that they rebate or refunds or money goes to, and although that is just an idea it is the one that we wanna explore down the road and the all tie into who is local here? Who can I support when my money stays local and where my community gets better". Then: "I'm kind of hoping that the Instagram posts and TikTok videos can help support this and that they can be used to say who the seller is with their business is about … I'm hoping that we can help Paige creators [Page owners], easily import those reels or videos or posts in some shape or form". Working name Who is local here? (others: Know your neighbor; The people behind it). Three parts: know your Page owner; your patronage supports a neighbor; where the money goes (explore later, money questions with socialus-legal). The owner's story is public and theirs to write; values answers stay private and light the blue dot only for aligned viewers (CO-0068, JY-VALUES). No stalking (PRINCIPLES.md, 2026-11-15). Related: "Locals, finding and supporting locals", a business is the people doing its work, the two-halves soul line, Bring it to life (JY-BRING), the launch campaign's vendor emails (CO-0070, JY-LAUNCH), F105, F106, CO-0019, CO-0040, CO-0031, CO-0039, CO-0027. Brief: socialus-plan planning/briefs/who-is-local-here-2026-11-23.md.
